name: Surge模块管理
description:
Surge 模块管理：在“模块管理”页面管理、分类、刷新和写入 Surge .sgmodule 模块；在 Script-Hub 页面使用上游 Script-Hub 测试版转换核心。支持远程链接、本地文本、格式识别、模块名/文件名/分类/User-Agent/请求头/高级参数、预览、Quantumult X/Loon/Surge/Egern/Shadowrocket/Scripting 平台导入，以及 Surge 模块一键写入。可选下载并本地化 [Script]、RULE-SET、DOMAIN-SET 和 #!include 中的远程资源，保持模块、脚本和规则集一起离线可用；脚本资源写入 Surge/Script，模块中的 script-path 同步为 Script/文件名，规则集和 include 保持 Surge 根目录，模块文件位置不变。所有引用都会与实际文件名校验一致，远程 basename 只作为默认命名依据。遇到转换链接时，本地化优先读取当前已安装模块作为源，避免把转换响应误判为 Surge 模块。Scripting 原生模块导入支持 .sgmodule 和 .plugin，不作为独立代理配置格式；Shadowrocket 支持模块快速导入，规则集在无法直接拉起时复制结果。

脚本启动后分为“模块管理”和“Script-Hub”两页，不内置在线模块市场，不维护第三方站点列表，也不会自动扫描或分发第三方内容。转换时会按用户操作把来源内容和参数发送到 Script-Hub 测试版，请勿填写敏感凭据。

快捷指令：可用 Scripting 的“运行脚本”调用本脚本来更新模块，也可以把多个 Surge .sgmodule 通过系统分享面板交给本脚本或快捷指令批量导入。参数示例：不传参数或传 all 更新全部远程模块；传分类名更新指定分类；传 JSON 更新指定分类、目录或模块名。批量本地化会串行写入，不逐个强制关闭/开启模块，避免触发 Surge 的频繁重载保护。

注意：需要先在设置页选择有效书签文件夹；如果书签权限失效，快捷指令会返回书签路径不可用提示。

localizedDescriptions.en:
Manage, categorize, refresh, and write Surge .sgmodule files in the Scripting tab. The Script-Hub tab uses the upstream Script-Hub beta conversion core, accepts remote URLs or local text, supports Quantumult X, Loon, Surge, Egern, Shadowrocket, and native Scripting module import, exposes advanced conversion parameters, and builds client import links. An optional setting synchronizes existing modules when saved, downloads remote [Script] script-path resources into iCloud Drive/Surge/Script, and rewrites each module script reference to Script/<basename>. RULE-SET, DOMAIN-SET, and #!include resources remain in the Surge root; module files are not moved. Every reference is verified against the actual local filename, and the remote URL basename is only the default name. Converter links use the installed module text first instead of treating a converter response as a Surge module, but this source fallback does not change the general naming rule. Turning the setting off and saving switches existing remote modules back to remote references while retaining downloaded files. Batch localization is serialized and does not force a disable/enable reload for every module. Native Scripting import accepts Surge .sgmodule and Loon .plugin files; Scripting is an import entry, not a separate proxy format. Shadowrocket modules can use the native import link, while rule-set results are copied when no direct import scheme is available.

The app has no bundled online market, third-party site list, automatic crawler, or redistributed third-party content. Conversion input and selected parameters are sent to Script-Hub beta only when the user performs a conversion action; do not enter sensitive credentials.

Shortcuts can run this script from Scripting to update all modules, a category, or selected names. Multiple local .sgmodule files can also be shared to this script or a Shortcut for batch import; each file is written and verified separately. Select the iCloud Drive Surge folder in Settings; the Module and Script subdirectories are created automatically when needed.
